QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Victoria Island Dispatch Complete
QuestInfo.0: You defeated the Puppeteer. Go back to 10 Boogies.
QuestInfo.1: The Victoria Island mission is complete. Return to Ereve and make an official report.
QuestInfo.2: You thwarted the Puppeteer, but he was only a low-ranking officer of the Black Wings. The organization is still out there, growing stronger by the day. Keep your guard up.
